9	head/.claude/adapters/cheval.py:2544 — The gate is enforced at dispatch, not at plan time. 5	## Finding
6	
7	``` text
8	head/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh:74 — [medium] The new "bare `:N`" branch's lookbehind only excludes `[A-Za-z0-9_./:]`, so any `:N` that follows a quote, backtick, asterisk or bracket gets bound to the most recently cited path. JSON-style text such as `"retries":40` or `"anchor_line":807` counts, and so does the review's own LOA-VERDICT trailer (`"critical":1,"high":1,…`). Reproduced: a review containing only `a.sh:1 … "retries":40` is credited with the a.sh:40 defect (recall 1.0), and one real citation plus the trailer is reported as `citations: 5`. This inflates recall, and the false-positive count on clean fixtures without a trailer. The Task 4.8 revert decision is measured with this 1.1.0 grader. Fix: require whitespace or start-of-line before a bare `:N`, or a literal `head:`/`base:`, and strip the trailer before scanning. RG-14 should cover `"x":40` and `**x**:40`.
9	head/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh:73 — [low] The comma-continuation rule `(?:\s*,\s*RNG)*` takes any number that follows a citation and a comma as another line of the same path. head/evals/graders/recall-vs-defects.sh:74 — [medium] The new "bare `:N`" branch's lookbehind only excludes `[A-Za-z0-9_./:]`, so any `:N` that follows a quote, backtick, asterisk or bracket gets bound to the most recently cited path. ## Finding

``` text
head/.claude/adapters/cheval.py:2297 — The D-1.1b "429 while unverified → RATE_LIMIT_UNVERIFIED, not walked" arm is unreachable in production: `invoke_with_retry` never re-raises `RateLimitError` (its arm backs off and loops, then raises `RetriesExhaustedError`), and the `except RetriesExhaustedError` arm at line 2338 walks the chain without consulting `_ceiling_unverified`. So a 429 above the probed bound still walks to the next voice and is never recorded for calibration. The e2e test only passes because `test_ceiling_e2e.py:116` patches `invoke_with_retry` itself to raise a raw `RateLimitError`.
head/.claude/adapters/loa_cheval/providers/retry.py:495 — The one-shot output-budget shrink uses `continue`; when the context-limit error lands on the final iteration (`attempt == max_retries`, e.g. after earlier 429s, or with `retry.max_retries: 0`) the loop ends and `RetriesExhaustedError` is raised with `last_error=None` instead of retrying at the shrunk budget. cheval then catches `RetriesExhaustedError` and walks the chain, violating the "provider verdict is never walked" contract and skipping the observed-bound record. `test_ceiling_retry.py` only covers `max_retries: 3` with the error on attempt 0.
head/.claude/scripts/flatline-orchestrator.sh:129 — The per-voice budget cap is 64000 while `DEFAULT_MODEL_TIMEOUT` is 120 s (line 115) and review/skeptic run at `--effort xhigh`; this reverses the cycle-124 invariant that a bounded Flatline call never meets a 64K generation insid …
```
